senses.gloss: nail of the human finger; claw; hoof; trnsf. pencil.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 17:1">Targ. Jer. XVII, 1</cite>.—

<cite ref="Chullin 17b">Ḥull. 17ᵇ</cite> the knife must be examined, <he>אבישרא ואט׳ וכ׳</he> on the fleshy top of the finger and on the nail &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>טוּפְרִין</he>, <cite ref="I00422"><he>טִפְ׳</he></cite>, <he>טוּפְרַיָּיא</he>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 5:22">Targ. Jud. V, 22</cite> (h. text <he>עקבות</he>) <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 21:12">Targ. O. Deut. XXI, 12</cite> <he>טוֹפְרָהָא</he> ed. Berl. (ed. Vien. <cite ref="I00211"><he>טוּפְרָנָהָא</he></cite>; Y. <he>טוּפְרַיָּיהָא</he>).—

<cite ref="Moed Katan 18a:2">M. Kat. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>חזנהו לטופריה וכ׳</he> (not <he>לטופרי</he>) saw that his nails were long; a. e.—Midr. Sam. ch. XI, v. <cite ref="A02379"><he>אִסְטְלִי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 30:34">Targ. O. Ex. XXX, 34</cite>.—[<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 3:7">Targ. Y. Gen. III, 7</cite> <he>לבוש טופרא</he>, read: <cite ref="U00511"><he>שׂוּפְרָא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 33:6">Lev. R. s. 33</cite> <he>טופרין ושער ועצמות</he>, read: <he>טפוסין של צלמים</he>, v. Yalk. Dan. 1061.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 32:4">Targ. Y. Ex. XXXII, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="I00209"><he>טוּפְסָא</he></cite>.]—V. <cite ref="I00211">next w.</cite>
